author: Bgamer123
quote:
Absolute failure on many levels. 
1. Bad writing bad pacing.
No classic gta edge with Brutally unfunny humor
2. Visual upgrade at the cost of extremely bad performance. 
3. Paywalls for items and subscriptions.
4. Censoring: certain groups have protection or completely removed from the game as a whole. Woke culture.
5. Purposely released at the end of a console lifecycle so you’re forced to purchase twice when online is released as you can assume it won’t run on current ps5/xbox. 
6. 0 innovation, example: I’m not asking for much but every “new” mechanic feels stripped from RDR2. 
Really sad to see Dan houser and the crew gone. This just isn’t like the fun games I’m used to from rockstar.
